title: Normalized geometric reduction and pullback model
statement: For every prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, and Operations o on the ringed sequence sites [def-strict-coefficient-system-operation-data], there exists a RealizationModel l E o [def-strict-coefficient-system-realization-data]: an ordinary direct-image/limit isomorphism satisfying its actual sectionwise projection formula and a derived reduction/pullback isomorphism whose whole-system K-flat representative equation is the one prescribed by that ordinary adjoint-conjugate comparison.

source.place: Primitive tensor reassociation, evaluation and adjunction unit/counit comparisons; agent-formulated component of lem-sf-integral-basic-realization.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary model by integralOrdinaryLimitModel: the normalized finite direct-image/evaluation and restriction comparisons assemble into a tower isomorphism, whose ordinary limit is compared by preservation of limits by the completed direct image.

The proved ringPull_preserves_flat helper for pro-etale ringed pullback sends flat-term K-flat complexes to flat-term K-flat complexes. Restrict the ordinary adjoint-conjugate comparison to their full subcategory and apply Q degreewise. Compose with the exact pullback factorization, the two published reduction model isomorphisms and the inverse exact sequence-pullback factorization. This gives a natural isomorphism after precomposition with the localization of good complexes.

Use the already proved localization of good complexes and Localization.liftNatIso to descend this natural isomorphism. Its component on a good complex is the constructed composite. Cancel the two inverse reduction-model and exact-pullback factorization pairs to obtain the displayed whole-system representative equation. Choose these derived isomorphisms for every scheme morphism and assemble the RealizationModel.

proof_origin.place: H8: ordinary tower comparison followed by localization of the normalized good-complex comparison, 2026-10-27.
